steps.say: As a tenant you must give at least 3 months’ notice in writing to end the tenancy early. This tenant break clause only has effect where the fixed term is for two years or more.
You cannot give that notice in the first 3 months, so the earliest the tenancy can end is after the first 6 months. That timing gives the landlord time to find a replacement tenant.

followups: Does the break clause apply under two years?
